chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Ibn Miskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“When the hadd is carried out upon the thief, he is banished to another town.”

key_terms.ٱلسَّارِقِ: the thief subject to the ruling

ai.seo_question: What happens to a thief after the hadd punishment is carried out in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the thief after the prescribed hadd has been carried out. It indicates that banishment to another town follows as part of the penal measure mentioned here.
